label: Counting paths
subgoals: Count one path into each primary input
Sum path counts over each gate's inputs in topological order
Double the output path total for rising and falling faults

label: Exponential growth
subgoals: Count paths into the node from the inputs
Count paths from the node to the outputs
Multiply the two counts for the paths through the node

label: Robust and non-robust tests
subgoals: Hold side inputs stable at non-controlling values for a robust test
Allow side inputs to settle by the second vector for a non-robust test
Select critical paths from static timing instead of enumerating all
